title: Untitled (Collage Panels Hanging)
description: Multiple collage panels clipped to a horizontal rod against a white-brick wall, collectively spanning a wide format. Imagery includes a pink sequined heart on black ground, compact discs, bullseye targets, soccer balls, a chess piece, gold-leaf fragments, and ribbon stripes across a dense red, black, and white ground.
composition: multiple panels clipped to horizontal rod
